name: USearch Open Source Vector Similarity Search
free_limit: Free Apache-2.0 embedded similarity search and clustering library for vectors; local single-file indexes with C++, Python, JavaScript, Rust and other language bindings, without a vendor-imposed query quota.
watch_out: This is an embedded library, not free managed search hosting. Your application provides CPU, memory, disk, indexing, backups and any cloud infrastructure; separate embedding models or APIs may cost money. Observe Apache-2.0 notices.
